from PIL import Image, ImageOps
import numpy as np
im=Image.open('radiograph.jpg').convert('L')
a=np.asarray(im).astype(float)
h,w=a.shape
# tile-based CLAHE approx
out=np.zeros_like(a)
ts=256
for y in range(0,h,ts):
    for x in range(0,w,ts):
        tile=a[y:y+ts,x:x+ts]
        lo,hi=np.percentile(tile,5),np.percentile(tile,95)
        if hi<=lo: hi=lo+1
        out[y:y+ts,x:x+ts]=np.clip((tile-lo)/(hi-lo)*255,0,255)
o=Image.fromarray(out.astype('uint8'))
o.resize((2000,980)).save('/tmp/clahe.png')
print('ok')
"", "description": "Tile-based local equalization"}
